title: chrysobalanus icaco subsp. orbicularis
intro: Chrysobalanus icaco subsp. orbicularis, commonly known as Ice Apple or Tahoo, is a plant species native to tropical Asia and Africa. It is valued for its fruit, which has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The Ice Apple fruit is rich in health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The plant's therapeutic actions are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, that exhibit antimicrobial, anti-diarrheal, and anti-inflammatory activities.
